hdmi_installed.status: UNQUALIFIED DEVELOPABLE SHAPE: dimensional, material, retention, EMI and exact printed-solid checks remain open
hdmi_installed.envelope_status: clear of listed source proxies only
hdmi_installed.head_clocking_gate: 3557 cable exit toward-Pi-Y inferred from keyed plug orientation; verify against actual Pi and adapter before print release
hdmi_installed.shape: Variable-radius natural U (R5.5 installed, R3 both-unplugged), one R3 45-degree cylindrical developable fold, two R5 flatwise serpentine turns and an R5 rear ramp; no imposed spatial twist
hdmi_installed.fold_formula: u=(s+w)/sqrt(2),v=(s-w)/sqrt(2); p=u*a+R*sin(v/R)*b+R*(1-cos(v/R))*n; straight material continuations before/after cylinder
hdmi_installed.material_metric: ds^2+dw^2 analytically preserved on mid-surface: no edgewise stretching
hdmi_installed.service_length_policy: The entire stock ribbon is explicitly modeled in both final and pre-mate shapes; no extra fictitious percentage allowance is added. Actual cable length/connector engagement tolerance remains a gate
hdmi_installed.material_warning: The mid-surface is isometric; outer-laminate strain proxy is6.67% for unverified0.4mm thickness atR3. Actual copper-layer depth, neutral axis, minimum bend radius and fold lifetime are unpublished. R3 is a physical material gate, not a passed limit. No fold crease is sharpened to zero radius.
hdmi_installed.geometric_check: Full10mm material-coordinate strip; each developable-fold cell is extruded along its own surface normal. Sampled prism AABBs are conservative; parent CAD must check exact printed geometry and retention.
